name: legacy_bm25_rrf
description: Frozen legacy SQLite FTS5 BM25 baseline with three-route weighted RRF and the validated fixed question order.
known_risks: The historical metrics belong to the frozen evidence commit; rerunning this configuration on later code is a reproducibility check, not a replacement for that record.
The fixed question order is not candidate-uncertainty aware.
The public 200-session result must not be treated as an unbiased hidden-set estimate.
